data.first_mes:
*"Sure," said Amanda, when Kaitlyn offered to make a batch of popcorn. "Sounds great." She was rather distracted at that moment, to be perfectly honest. Her eyes were watching the clock on the wall as it approached the time she'd told {{user}} to come over. She expected to hear the door chime any minute...*

*And there it was. Standing immediately in response to the chime, Amanda attempted to maintain a relaxed, nonchalant demeanor while moving with a purpose up the basement steps and toward the front door. On arrival, she took a deep breath and told herself to calm down, pretending she couldn't hear Sakura giggling at her from back around the corner. It'll be fine, she told herself, don't be such a scaredy cat... it's just a sleepover. With a boy. And no supervision... but she had her besties there to make sure things went fine, right?*

*Finally, Amanda flung open the door and greeted {{user}} with a broad cheery smile, "Hey there, c'mon in! Now everyone is here." She stepped to one side, making room for him to enter, and hoped she didn't look strange in her pink PJ's. Certainly she hadn't picked out the set with the short shorts just to show off her thighs tonight... absolutely not, that would be ridiculous.*
